Class.comment: Occurrence Class, used to categorize Occurrences

UIText.comment: Text to use, if any, in the player score area

CountdownUIText.comment: Text to use, if any, in the player score area when an Occurrence is upcoming. The entry with the smallest value that is within the amount of turns until the Occurrence will be used.

StartBonus.comment: This bonus is applied to all players affected by the Occurrence once, when the Occurrence starts

EffectPlayer.comment: This effectPlayer is applied to all players affected by the Occurrence while it is active

EffectCity.comment: This effectCity is applied to all cities on tiles affected by the Occurrence while it is active

EffectCityTerritory.comment: This effectCity is applied to all cities with one or more tiles affected by the Occurrence while it is active

EffectUnit.comment: This effectUnit is applied to all units affected by the Occurrence while is active

MemoryPlayerEnd.comment: This memoryPlayer is applied to all players affected by the Occurrence when it ends

MemoryPlayerInvalid.comment: Invalid if this memory is active for any player affected by the Occurrence

MinDifficultyAll.comment: The Occurrence will only be valid if all human players are at this Difficulty or higher.

MaxDifficultyAll.comment: The Occurrence will only be valid if all human players are at this Difficulty or lower.

TerrainPrereq.comment: The Occurrence will only be valid if the map has a tile of this Terrain

HelpText.comment: Optional extra tooltip info text about occurrence

AffectTerrain.comment: The Occurrence will affect all tiles of this type. If this is used, the contiguous checks above will be ignored

IgnoreTerrain.comment: The Occurrence will ignore all tiles of this Terrain type.

TileContiguousTerrain.comment: For Occurrences applied to a tile, the Occurrence will also apply to contiguous tiles of this TerrainTarget

iMinTurns.comment: The minimum turn that must be reached before the Occurrence can start

iMaxTurns.comment: The maximum turn after which the Occurrence can no longer start

iDelayTurns.comment: The number of turns until the Occurrence will take effect once it is triggered

iRepeatTurns.comment: The minimum amount of turns between instances of this Occurrence. Does not matter which player(s) the Occurrence was valid for.

iRepeatTurnsPlayer.comment: The minimum amount of turns for any given player between instances of this Occurrence

iMinDuration.comment: The minimum duration, in turns, of the Occurrence

iMaxDuration.comment: The maximum duration, in turns, of the Occurrence

iStartChance.comment: The percent chance, per turn, that the Occurrence will start if it passes all validity checks

iEndChance.comment: The base percent chance, per turn, that the Occurrence will end.

iEndChanceIncrement.comment: The additional percent chance, incremented by this value each turn, that the Occurrence will end.

iCityDamage.comment: Cities will take this amount of damage per turn.

iCityDamageCoastal.comment: Coastal cities will take this amount of damage per turn.

iCityPillageImprovements.comment: Pillage this many random improvements per City.

iCityPillageImprovementsCoast.comment: Pillage this many random coastal improvements per City.

iTileUnitDamage.comment: Units on tiles affected by the Occurrence will suffer this much damage per turn.

iTileMovementCostExtra.comment: Extra movement cost to be added to tiles affected by the Occurrence.

iTilePillageChance.comment: Improvements on tiles affected by the Occurrence will have this percent chance of being pillaged.

iTileBaseYieldModifier.comment: Base Yields on tiles affected by the Occurrence will be modified by this amount.

iTileRevealChange.comment: Extra vision penalty to be added to tiles affected by the Occurrence.

iTileVegetationReduceChance.comment: The chance that vegetation of this type on affected tiles will be reduced to its VegetationRemove value. Improvements will be pillaged, and the effect may spread to adjacent tiles.

iTileContiguousRange.comment: Used with bTileContiguous* and aeTileContiguous* to limit the range of affected tiles.

bEncyclopedia.comment: Whether to appear in the Encyclopedia. Enabled by default.

bDetails.comment: Whether to display the specific effects in the Occurrence helptext. Enabled by default.

bMajor.comment: Only one major event be active at a time.

bForceGlobal.comment: The Occurrence will be considered global, regardless of what tiles it affects.

bMultiples.comment: Occurrence will not block other occurrences from triggering on same turn.

bNoDuplicates.comment: If enabled, only one Occurrence of this type can be active at a time.

bNoEndEvent.comment: If enabled, no related 'end' event will be triggered when the Occurrence is over.

bAffectAllRiver.comment: The Occurrence will affect all river-adjacent tiles on the map. If this is used, contiguous checks will be ignored.

bTileTargetPlayerOwned.comment: For Occurrences applied to a tile, only player-owned tiles will be considered. Used with iStartChance.

bTileContiguousFreshWater.comment: For Occurrences applied to a tile, the Occurrence will also apply to contiguous fresh water source or river tiles

bUpdateAffectedTiles.comment: For use with aeAffectTerrain. Helpful for Occurrences that modify terrain

bTilePillage.comment: Improvements on tiles affected by the Occurrence will be pillaged.

bTileUnanchor.comment: Anchored ships on affected tiles will be unanchored.

bTileAffectAdjacent.comment: Apply effects to tiles adjacent to those determined by tile contiguity/terrain/height/etc checks

bShowAffectedCharacters.comment: If enabled, lists in helptext any Characters affected by Traits in aiTraitProb.

aiVegetationReduceChance.comment: The chance that vegetation of this type will be reduced to its VegetationRemove. Improvements will be pillaged, and the effect may spread to adjacent tiles

aiTraitProb.comment: The likelihood that characters will acquire a trait while the Occurrence is active

TraitGainText.comment: The trait gain text for each Trait associated with aiTraitProb above

aiTraitRemoveProbEnd.comment: The likelihood that characters will lose these Traits when the Occurrence ends

aeTileTargetSubjectAny.comment: The Occurrence will apply to a tile of one of the specified subject types. Requires iStartChance > 0

aeOccurrenceRepeatTurns.comment: List of additional Occurrences that iRepeatTurns checks against.

aaiTileTerrainChangeChance.comment: Affected tiles of this terrain will have the specified chance (out of 10,000) to change to the second specified terrain
